concrete_scene.heading: Worked hive placement: the three-minute rented GPU loses
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A policy-first hive scheduler choosing between a fifteen-minute home desktop and a three-minute rented GPU
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Render and validate a private draft under local-only data policy, phone approval, zero external spend, and a dropout residual.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The faster rented node is rejected for private-data and tool-policy mismatch, while the home desktop receives a job-scoped local render approval.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The trace tests whether reachability, high compute fit, or lower estimated latency licenses work placement; policy eligibility must be established first.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The hive decision retains unexecuted dropout recovery, audit replay, approval expiry, device revocation, energy budget, and no-private-export obligations.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The two valid and eight invalid records are synthetic admission fixtures; no scheduler, registry, network, approval service, guardian policy, sandbox, federation, energy measure, or dropout recovery ran.

worked_trace.heading: Worked hive placement: the three-minute rented GPU loses
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The fixture validates policy-first admission and eight typed rejection boundaries only; it establishes no runtime scheduling quality, privacy, security, energy, recovery, federation, or useful-work result.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: Latency-first scheduling selects the three-minute rented GPU, but that route violates local-only private-data and tool boundaries; policy filtering makes it ineligible before optimization begins.
readable_claim: A hive chooses the fastest eligible device, not the fastest reachable device.
normative_rule: Filter every node by principal, data, tool, approval, secret, locality, energy, federation, dropout, and residual policy before comparing latency or price. A partition or stale grant routes high-impact work to denial, quarantine, or fresh approval rather than available-but-unauthorized execution.
